desc:
MUG CAKE BROWNIE: Make a delicious brownie dessert without the fuss

QUICK AND EASY: Make brownie mug cake by adding water and popping in the microwave

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare mug cake mix as is or explore the many Betty Crocker creative recipe.

MICROWAVE BROWNIE: Enjoy an individual serving of brownie goodness without turning on the oven

CONTAINS: 13.9 oz
features:
Features

Decadent Chocolate Brownie Flavor: Delivers a rich, moist brownie experience in a single serving.
Includes Fudge Topping: Each serving comes with a separate pouch of gooey chocolate fudge to drizzle over the top.
Microwave-Ready: Designed for quick prep in a mug—just add water or milk and microwave for about a minute.
Single-Serve Format: Perfectly portioned to satisfy sweet cravings without overindulging.
Multipack Box: Comes with 6 pouches, making it easy to enjoy multiple treats or share.
Minimal Cleanup: No bowls or pans needed—just mix and bake right in the mug.

Benefits

Quick & Convenient: Ready in just about a minute, making it perfect for busy days or sudden cravings.
Easy to Use: No baking experience needed—just mix, heat, and enjoy.
Perfect for Portion Control: Single-serve design prevents over-snacking while still delivering satisfaction.
Great for Customization: Add extras like chopped nuts, mini marshmallows, or whipped cream for a personalized desser
Kid-Friendly: Safe and simple enough for kids to make with little to no supervision.
Comforting Dessert Anytime: Warm, rich, and gooey—perfect for cozy nights or quick sweet fixes.
ingredients: Sugar, Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, artificial flavor), Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Canola Oil, Nonfat Milk, Water, High Fructose Corn Syrup. Contains 2% or less of: Hydrogenated Palm Kernel Oil, Corn Starch, Egg White, Cocoa, Corn Syrup, Buttermilk, Salt, Butter, Whey, Sodium Alginate, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Potassium Sorbate (preservative), Mono and Diglycerides, Baking Soda, Color Added.
